description: The next_action object returned by next, take, progress, and context must name the next tool and its arguments, not a shell command string. During the additive 0.5.0 release it also dual-emits the legacy command string for the Pi adapter and the skill; 0.6.0 drops command. Audit every embedded command string in agent.py and tracker.py (agent.py lines around 227, 265, 283, 326, 501, 507, 516, 528; tracker.py around 1636) and the human_action_required variants that name todo unblock and todo dismiss.

next_action still distinguishes agent steps from human_action_required steps
